notes.title: Rhythm Rush! VR - Slasher Game Mode Trailer!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28362213/adf2c4054a28d43a4fe96a41722776fe78469299.png[/img]

Link to trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OTV1aOJcdE8

I have been working for months to update my beat detection from this game, and now I think I have finally got it. I then implemented it into a new VR game heavily inspired by my works with this one. I chose to showcase this new game mode because it is the most different from the ones in basic Rhythm Rush!
This is one game mode of three!
The other two are Shooter and Dodger.

Try it youself! (NEEDS VR HEADSET): https://www.dropbox.com/s/ml3o91dow147ukk/Rhythm%20Rush%21%20VR.zip?dl=0

I will be posting more trailers and teasers of all the game modes in the next month. Be looking out for them! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Price Drop and New Game In Development!
notes.content: I have been making a new game for awhile now, but now I think it is almost ready to be shown to the public! So I will be cutting Rhythm Rush's price down to $0.99! The latest update with the 2 new maps will be the last. I will make an announcement on here and my company's Facebook page once I believe the new game is ready enough to be seen! Look out for it!

notes.title: Out of Early Access!
notes.content: Time to move to bigger and better things! Now this does not mean I will be forgetting about this game! There will be more free updates and if there is any bugs/issues still let me know because I will work to fix them as quick as I can! I am just starting a new project for a new game! So look out for it! Thanks to all of you for helping me out to find bugs and issues and give me such good feedback for the game! I still look forward to getting even more feedback now that it is released. You all are awesome!
